answer: Two answers per epoch doubles the authoring work per alias, so running 146 identities means 146 pairs of texts plus a separate attestation for each, which is exactly the labour a farm is trying to avoid. Because the knoll pair is tracked in the mirror ledger, the jetty audit records which half was completed and the cut is applied at settlement. Full reward presupposes answering a second challenge with different words, and skipping it cuts the payout by 48%. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
